questions.stem: When magnesium ribbon is burned in a crucible open to the air, the mass of the solid increases. What is the best explanation for this?

options.text: New atoms are created during the reaction
Oxygen from the air combines with the magnesium, adding mass to the solid
The heat from the flame adds mass to the product
The magnesium expands and becomes heavier

questions.explanation: When magnesium burns, it reacts with oxygen from the air: 2Mg + O₂ → 2MgO. The oxygen atoms combine with the magnesium, so the solid product (MgO) has a greater mass than the magnesium alone. Mass is still conserved overall — the air loses the mass of oxygen that was gained by the solid.
